His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia

The presence of fixed delusions (paranoia, grandeur regarding mind control), disorganized behavior, social withdrawal, and functional decline over 3 months strongly points to schizophrenia. Given the lack of positive toxicology, metabolic panel, or thyroid abnormalities, an organic cause is unlikely.
